ambiguities_or_notes: The long Lamennais quotation is translated from Tolstoy's Russian compilation and retains the repeated claims about liberation, human masters, justice, mercy, and divine law.

Свобода состоит не в том, чтобы властвовал этот, а не тот, а в том, чтобы никто не властвовал is preserved directly as freedom consisting in no one ruling, rather than softened into a vaguer anti-authoritarian paraphrase.
The wool-and-vessels image is kept literally enough to preserve Tolstoy's comparison, and all three source page markers are retained.
